representation: Whiten by y=A^{1/2}x. Set a_i=A^{1/2}e_i, B_i=a_i a_i^T, and P_i=I-B_i; then B_i are rank-one projections, sum_i B_i=A, and Q_pi=P_{pi_n}...P_{pi_1} represents an epoch in Euclidean norm. Represent the random epoch by the noncommutative second-moment map Phi(X)=E_pi[Q_pi X Q_pi^T], equivalently by E_pi[Q_pi tensor Q_pi].
state_or_invariant: For each prefix length s, retain H_s=(1/(n)_s) sum_{i_1,...,i_s distinct} W_i^T W_i, where W_i=P_{i_s}...P_{i_1}. Thus H_0=I, H_n=E_pi[Q_pi^T Q_pi], and H_0 >= H_1 >= ... >= H_n >= 0 in Loewner order. Also retain the covariance R_k=E[y_k y_k^T], which evolves exactly as R_{k+1}=Phi(R_k), with E||y_k||^2=tr(R_k).
core_candidate_lemma: Permutation-symmetrized noncommutative frame inequality: for every finite spanning family of unit vectors with rank-one projections B_i and lower frame bound mu=lambda_min(sum_i B_i), the polynomial loss D=I-H_n=(1/n!) sum_pi sum_{s=1}^n W_{pi,s-1}^T B_{pi_s} W_{pi,s-1}, where W_{pi,s-1}=P_{pi_{s-1}}...P_{pi_1}, satisfies D >= (mu/16) I.
predicted_failure: The lower frame bound alone may not control the ordered polynomial loss. In a highly coherent, nearly rank-one frame, the first few projections can create components that cancel the small innovation directions seen by later projections, potentially making lambda_min(D)=o(mu). The discarded identity of the early coordinates would then be essential, and the prefix-averaged second-moment hierarchy would be too coarse.
falsifier: In a later phase, analyze symbolically the equicorrelation family A_{n,delta}=delta I+(1-delta)11^T with delta=n^{-2}, form B_i=(A_{n,delta}^{1/2}e_i)(A_{n,delta}^{1/2}e_i)^T, and exploit permutation symmetry to evaluate the contrast eigenvalue using v=e_1-e_2. The exact candidate edge is rejected if v^T(I-H_n)v/(delta v^T v)<1/16 for any n, and its proposed mu scaling is rejected analytically if this ratio tends to zero as n tends to infinity. This check is named but not executed here.
target_implication: The candidate lemma gives H_n <= (1-mu/16)I, hence E[||y_{k+1}||^2 | y_k] <= (1-mu/16)||y_k||^2. Fresh independent permutations then give E||y_k||^2 <= (1-mu/16)^k||y_0||^2. Jensen's inequality yields E||x_k||_A <= exp(-mu k/32)||x_0||_A, so the target holds with C=1 and c=1/32.
information_retained: The full Loewner-matrix prefix moments H_s, rather than only their traces.
All noncommutative word order inside each prefix product.
The exact frame operator sum_i B_i=A and its lower eigenvalue mu.
The covariance lift and fresh-epoch independence needed for iteration.
information_discarded: The identities of coordinates inside the uniform average over prefixes of equal length.
The pathwise iterate distribution beyond its second moment.
Higher tensor moments of y_k and first-moment cancellation information.
